bank.name: Defence & Nuclear
bank.subject: Pakistan Affairs
bank.description: Pakistan's armed forces, wars, defence day, and the nuclear weapons programme.

questions.prompt: Pakistan observes Defence Day (Youm-e-Difa) on which date?
questions.explanation: 6 September commemorates the 1965 war against India.

questions.prompt: The 1965 Indo-Pakistan war lasted for how many days?
questions.explanation: The war ran from 6 to 22 September 1965, about 17 days.

questions.prompt: The Pakistan Army was formally established in which year?
questions.explanation: The Pakistan Army came into being on 14 August 1947.

questions.prompt: The Royal Pakistan Air Force was renamed the Pakistan Air Force in which year?
questions.explanation: The air force dropped the 'Royal' prefix when Pakistan became a republic in 1956.

questions.prompt: The Pakistan Military Academy (PMA), where army officers are trained, is located at?
questions.explanation: The Pakistan Military Academy is at Kakul, Abbottabad.

questions.prompt: The Inter-Services Intelligence (ISI) agency was founded in which year?
questions.explanation: ISI was established in 1948 under Major General Cawthorne.

questions.prompt: Pakistan's nuclear tests on 28 May 1998 were conducted at?
questions.explanation: The tests, codenamed Chagai-I, were conducted in the Chagai Hills of Balochistan.

questions.prompt: Pakistan's nuclear tests of 1998 were a response to nuclear tests by which country?
questions.explanation: India conducted tests at Pokhran in May 1998, prompting Pakistan's response.

questions.prompt: India's nuclear test site of 1998 is called?
questions.explanation: India tested at Pokhran in Rajasthan in May 1998.

questions.prompt: Pakistan's Ghauri missile is named after which historical conqueror?
questions.explanation: The Ghauri missile is named after Sultan Muhammad Ghori.

questions.prompt: The 1971 war between Pakistan and India ended with the surrender of Pakistani forces in Dhaka on?
questions.explanation: The surrender took place on 16 December 1971.

questions.prompt: The Kargil conflict between Pakistan and India occurred in which year?
questions.explanation: The Kargil conflict was fought in the summer of 1999.

questions.prompt: Who is the current chain of command head of the Pakistan Army?
questions.explanation: The COAS commands the army under the constitution.

questions.prompt: The headquarters of the Pakistan Army is located in?
questions.explanation: The General Headquarters (GHQ) is in Rawalpindi.

questions.prompt: The Pakistan Navy's main base is?
questions.explanation: Karachi hosts the principal naval base and fleet headquarters.

questions.prompt: The Pakistan Air Force headquarters is located at?
questions.explanation: PAF headquarters is at the PAF Complex in Islamabad.

questions.prompt: The JF-17 Thunder fighter jet is a joint project of Pakistan and?
questions.explanation: The JF-17 is co-developed by Pakistan (PAC) and China (CAC).

questions.prompt: Pakistan's first nuclear test on 28 May 1998 was conducted at?
questions.explanation: Five devices were detonated at the Ras Koh hills in Chagai, Balochistan.

questions.prompt: The codename of Pakistan's 1998 nuclear tests was?
questions.explanation: The tests were codenamed Chagai-I; India's 1974 test was 'Smiling Buddha'.

questions.prompt: Who was the prime minister of Pakistan during the 1998 nuclear tests?
questions.explanation: Nawaz Sharif ordered the tests after India's Pokhran-II detonations.

questions.prompt: Pakistan's surface-to-surface missile 'Shaheen' is named after?
questions.explanation: Shaheen (falcon) is the codename for Pakistan's solid-fuel ballistic missile family.

questions.prompt: The 'Ghauri' missile is named after which historical figure?
questions.explanation: Ghauri is named after Sultan Shahab-ud-Din Muhammad Ghori, who conquered Delhi.

questions.prompt: Which Pakistani missile is a cruise missile with 'Babur' as its name?
questions.explanation: Babur is Pakistan's ground-launched cruise missile, named after Emperor Babur.

questions.explanation: The 1965 war began with skirmishes in Kashmir, escalating to a full-scale conflict.

questions.prompt: The Battle of Chawinda (1965) is considered?
options: One of the largest tank battles since World War II
questions.explanation: Chawinda in Punjab saw major armoured engagements between Pakistan and India.

questions.prompt: 'Youm-e-Shuhada' (Martyrs' Day) is observed on?
questions.explanation: 30 April is observed as Martyrs' Day to honour those who gave their lives for Pakistan.

questions.prompt: Who was the Commander-in-Chief of Pakistan Army during the 1965 war?
questions.explanation: General Muhammad Musa led the army; Ayub Khan was president.

options: Conspicuous gallantry in the face of the enemy

questions.prompt: The 'Naval Academy' of Pakistan is at?

questions.prompt: The 'Air Force Academy' (Asghar Khan Academy) is at?

questions.prompt: The 'Abdali' (Hatf-II) missile is?

questions.prompt: The 'Shaheen-III' missile's range is approximately?

questions.prompt: The 'Sword of Honour' at PMA is awarded to?

questions.prompt: The 'Karakoram' mountain range forms a natural border with?

questions.prompt: The 'PNS Zulfiqar' and 'PNS Saif' are?
